segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the 42-seat quote and make sure the July 15 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep. July 15 is still the target. We may start with 38 seats and add the last four after finance signs off, but I need the invoice to match what procurement approved.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The pricing sheet has 38 seats at $86 per user per month, billed annually, so that lands at $39,216 before tax. If you add the other four by September 1, we can keep them at the same rate.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation fee was $4,500, right? I saw $5,000 on one version.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: You're right, there were two drafts. Sorry for the lag cleaning that up; yesterday got eaten by updating the CRM records, fixing account fields, and assembling the internal deal desk packet, so I had less time on customer calls than I planned. The correct implementation fee is $4,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No problem. I just need the order form clean because our controller will kick it back if the numbers don't line up.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I'll send one order form with 38 seats, $39,216 annual subscription, $4,500 implementation, net 30 terms, and the July 15 start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can you also add that support is included? Legal asked whether the standard support hours are part of the subscription.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, standard support is included, Monday through Friday, 8 to 6 Central. Premium support is separate, but you are not buying that here.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it over today if you can. If finance approves tomorrow, I can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll have the revised order form and invoice preview in your inbox by 3:00 p.m. today.
